home.description: Turn USB modems and Android phones into a managed SMS gateway: one operator UI for every port, number sales on autopilot and automatic updates.
home.title: Run your modem farm like infrastructure
home.shotAlt: Gateway Soft: port list and the detail of a modem
home.featuresText: From the first USB modem to a rack of them, from a desktop to a server without a screen.

ports.title: Every port at a glance
ports.text: Signal, operator, number and sale state of each modem; filters for issues; one click to the port’s logs, SMS and USSD.

selling.title: Sells numbers by itself
selling.text: Reads the number from the SIM, lists it on the reseller server, forwards SMS and handles rent, bans and number changes.

headless.title: Remote access from a browser
headless.text: Open the gateway from another computer or a phone with a login; on a server it can also run without a window.

phone.title: Phones as gateways
phone.text: Gateway Phone sells the SIM cards of an Android phone on its own: no computer, no USB modem.

hardware.title: Built for real modems
hardware.text: Profiles for Quectel, SIMCom, Huawei, ZTE, Wavecom and more; timeouts, retries and recovery tuned on hardware.

updates.title: Updates itself
updates.text: Desktop and headless installs check the release feed and install new versions; the phone app updates too.

home.editionsTitle: On a computer or on a phone
home.editionsText: One release feed, one account, the same features.

desktop.title: Desktop app
desktop.text: Windows, macOS and Linux. Tray, notifications, the full operator UI.

phone.title: Gateway Phone
phone.text: An Android app that sells the phone’s own SIM cards.

home.stepsText: Install with one command, sign in, plug the modems in.

install.title: Install
install.text: Pick the installer for your system on the downloads page.

login.title: Log in
login.text: Sign in with your seller account; the gateway keeps the session.

modems.title: Plug in modems
modems.text: Add the ports once; numbers go on sale as SIMs are read.

home.ctaText: Windows, macOS, Linux and Android from the same release.
